text:
olivia: FYI posting follow-up tasks from the morning TLS handshake flap. Postmortem: https://redwood.in/pm/4389 :memo:

ashok: quick summary for folks - cert rotator pushed a cert missing an intermediate to ~3% of edge nodes; control-plane retries then caused cross-region failover and retry storms.

kevin: confirmed in LB logs: repeated `tls: handshake error` and subsequent 502 spikes between 09:03-09:10 UTC.

jade: plan for router guard: block async route swap if backend health-error-rate > 1% for 30s. Will submit PR for hotpatching.

sam: monitoring items: add TLS-handshake-rate alert, cross-region retry heatmap, synthetic cross-region handshake probes. ETA 4 days.

maria: runbook updates: add "validate cert chain on sample nodes before rotate" and an emergency rollback checklist. Will PR tonight.

ashok: I own cert validation. Deliverable: dry-run step that verifies full chain, and a pre-rollout sample check (5% of nodes). Target: Thu EOD.

kevin: Jade and I will reproduce the control-plane delay in staging and run the canary. Repro by Wed, fix candidate by Fri.

jade: once we have repro, we'll run a limited canary across 2 regions and verify retry reduction > 40% before prod.

sre-bot: incident INC-2026-4389 created. 72h follow-up reminder scheduled.

olivia: blockers: need 30d LB telemetry retention for recurrence analysis. @finance-bot please approve budget for extra storage.

finance-bot: flagged for review. estimated incremental cost ~ $1.2k/month.

sam: small note - the weekly recurrence job should look for clusters of handshake errors that co-occur with route-eject events (windowed analysis).

ashok: snippet for validator: `openssl s_client -connect $NODE:443 -showcerts | openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/chain.pem` will be part of dry-run.

maria: consolidated owners + dates:
- Ashok: cert validation dry-run PR 126 127 026-04-02
- Kevin & Jade: routing repro + patch 126-04-01 (repro), 126-04-03 (patch)
- Sam: alerts + synthetic probes 126-04-05
- Olivia: infra retention request submitted today
- Maria: runbook PR 126-03-31

kevin: created tracking card RT-2240 and linked postmortem. Will update with test results.

jade: small opt: add a backoff multiplier to LB retries when cross-region path is detected. Low-risk, will test in stage.

olivia: please post PR links in-thread and update the tracking card before the 72h check-in (1796176400).

maria: thanks team. we'll triage any regressions during the canary window and escalate to infra if telemetry costs spike.

kevin: noted. I'll add a log-sampling rule to avoid huge storage growth during the spike.

maria: check-in scheduled. Close items when done. :thumbsup:
